messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: simulated annealing over continuous coordinate pairs

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Simulated annealing over continuous coordinate pairs converges to a configuration where 13 points lie on three concentric scaled copies of a regular hexagonal/triangular lattice, achieving a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/156. This exceeds the naive grid lower bound of 1/144 and arises because the three-layer hexagonal perturbation eliminates all near-degenerate collinear triples while maintaining uniform local density."}
